image_description: A close-up shot of a Great White Pelican floating on blue water. The bird is facing right, with its head turned slightly back. Its distinctive long bill and gular pouch are visible. The plumage is white/cream with some greyish tones on the wings. Another pelican's wing/back is partially visible on the left edge. The water has gentle ripples.
